text:
ana: heads up — starting a quick PRD intake thread for an eval-driven auto-rollback feature for Dedicated customers. problem statement in the next msg

mike_p: high level ask: some customers want automatic rollback when model quality drops below tenant-specific thresholds during canary/rollout. want to scope requirements + success metrics.

jess: can we be explicit about what "quality" means per tenant? precision/recall? hallucination rate? latency impact?

ana: typo — ana :) for quality let's target a small set of metrics initially: generation F1 on customer prompt set, hallucination flag rate (heuristic), and top-level latency p95. non-goal: re-defining eval metrics for every customer.

sam_g: proposal: two-layer gate: (1) soft-warning (notify + pause new canary traffic), (2) hard-rollback (automatic switch to previous model). both triggered by configurable thresholds per-tenant.

eli_research: +1. need to define evaluation cadence and sample size. Suggest rolling window of last 500 requests or 24h whichever first. also need a notion of statistical significance to avoid flapping.

mike_p: acceptance criteria draft: 
```
- Admin can configure per-tenant thresholds for: quality_score, hallucination_rate, latency_p95
- System evaluates against tenant-provided prompt set + live-sampled requests
- If metric breaches soft threshold for >= 2 evaluation windows -> send alert + pause canary traffic
- If metric breaches hard threshold for >= 3 windows -> trigger rollback to previous model variant and notify
- Rollback must complete within SLA (30s for control plane ops)
```

jess: edge cases: tenants with <500 requests/day, requests with private data (can't keep prompt text), and multi-model rollouts (A->B->C). we need fallbacks for small-volume tenants and privacy-safe eval.

ana: non-goal: automatic retraining or model tuning. also not doing automated customer-facing explanations in v1.

sam_g: implementation notes: rely on existing eval harness + streaming metrics pipeline. need a small service for per-tenant thresholds + state machine for gate (soft pause / rollback). gating decisions must be auditable.

eli_research: success metrics (product/eng):
- false positive rollback rate < 1% on canaries run in staging
- mean time to detect a real regression <= 15m
- customer-reported production regressions reduced by 60% for customers using auto-rollback
- performance overhead <= 3% CPU on serving plane

mike_p: risks: noisy metrics -> unnecessary rollbacks, config sprawl (per-tenant proliferation), security/privacy for storing prompt sets. mitigation ideas: default templates, global safeties, sampling + differential privacy for stored prompts.

jess: question: who owns rollout UI? product + console infra? I'd like a tiny config surface in the Console for per-tenant thresholds and an audit log view.

ana: product to own config UX, infra to own execution + audit logs. we should add an API endpoint for infra-as-code customers too.

sam_g: timeline guesses: 6wk MLP (eval infra + decision service + minimal console), 12wk GA (privacy features + templates + docs).

mike_p: next steps: ana to draft PRD with problem statement, goals/non-goals, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and sample tenant configs. assign owners for infra, eval, console, compliance.

ana: i'll draft and post PRD tomorrow. tagging: @mike_p @jess @sam_g @eli_research for review. thanks! :raised_hands:
